items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Badge '!' , deep link and no-triage-log rule all implemented as the three frozen ACs; nothing extra added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Deep link tolerates stale or unknown project/item (consumed once, list stays); isNoTriageLog only matches the exact FileNotFoundError suffix, every other exception name stays an error.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: project/item query values are only compared against loaded entries and encodeURIComponent-built on the way out; no HTML sinks, no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Unit tests per behavior (badge, cannotRead, deep link hook, openTriage, server parse incl. PermissionError error path) plus a 3-test real-browser E2E.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: reminderProblems is a cheap pure pass over the already-fetched answer in MainLayout; the hook effect is keyed on stable values and only acts when both params are present.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: TriagePage.tsx grows by 2 lines (263, baseline limit 300); new hook in hooks/, files under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: HTTP/CLI contract parse changed (triageError normalised to null for the no-log case); producer wording pinned by the new server test, consumer covered by the client tests.
